Facebook employs 3300 employees, and one-third of them are men. So, the number of women employees is 3300 - 3300/3 = 2200.
Of the women, 1200 are not mothers, so the number of female mother employees is 2200 - 1200 = <<2200-1200=1000>>1000.
The productivity bonus will total 25% of Facebook's annual earnings, which was $5,000,000 for the year 2020. So, the total bonus is 5,000,000 * 25/100 = <<5000000*25/100=1250000>>1,250,000.
Since each female mother employee received an equal amount, the bonus that each female mother employee received is 1,250,000 / 1000 = <<1250000/1000=1250>>1250.
#### 1250
